live_probe.interpretation: 405 confirms path is registered on the live Clockify API and GET is not the supported method. PUT is the registered method — consistent with the project-user cost-rate pattern already confirmed live (PUT /projects/{projectId}/users/{userId}/cost-rate returns 405 on GET, 200 on PUT).

source_analysis.note: No typed MCP tool sets the workspace-level user cost rate. The project-scoped equivalent is handled by clockify_projects_rates_update (internal/tools/project_admin.go:179-180) using path projects/{projectId}/users/{userId}/cost-rate. The workspace-level /users/{userId}/cost-rate path has no corresponding typed tool.
source_analysis.related_raw_allowlist_line: raw_allowlist_gen.go:179 also registers 'PUT /workspaces/{workspaceId}/users/{userId}/hourly-rate': true (same gap — no typed tool)

conclusion: 405 on GET confirms path is registered and PUT is the supported method. No typed MCP tool exists for workspace-level user cost-rate. This is a gap: the project-scoped version has clockify_projects_rates_update but there is no clockify_users_rates_update or equivalent. Raw fallback only via CLOCKIFY_ENABLE_RAW_WRITES=true.
